tools.name: pi-digits
tools.description: Returns a slice of the digits of pi. Requires a math.tools API token (numbers:* ability).

from.description: Start offset into the digits of pi. Defaults to 0.

to.description: End offset into the digits of pi. Defaults to 100. Must be >= from.

tools.name: number-facts
tools.description: Get a trivia fact about a specific number, a batch of random integers, or today's curated number of the day. Requires a math.tools API token (numbers:* ability).

action.description: Which lookup to perform. 'fact' needs number; 'random' returns one or more random integers; 'number-of-the-day' returns today's curated pick.

number.description: Required when action is 'fact' — the number to look up.

total.description: For action 'random': how many numbers to return (capped server-side).

category.description: For action 'number-of-the-day': the category shortname. Defaults to the site's default category.

tools.name: spell-number
tools.description: Spell a number out in words: cardinal (e.g. "seven"), ordinal (e.g. "7th"), or currency (e.g. "seven dollars"). Requires a math.tools API token (numbers:* ability).

lang.description: Locale for cardinal/currency, e.g. 'en_US', 'fr_FR'. Not used for ordinal (English only). Defaults to the site default.

tools.name: convert-numeral
tools.description: Convert a base-10 number to another numeral system: Roman, Chinese, Egyptian, Babylonian (sexagesimal digits), or Mayan (vigesimal, real Unicode glyphs). Requires a math.tools API token (numbers:* ability).

tools.name: gcf-lcm
tools.description: Compute the greatest common factor (GCF/GCD) or least common multiple (LCM) of two or more numbers. Requires a math.tools API token (numbers:* ability).

numbers.description: Comma-separated list of integers, e.g. '12,18,24'. At least two values.

tools.name: number-lists
tools.description: The first N prime numbers, composite numbers, or palindromic numbers. Requires a math.tools API token (numbers:* ability).

count.description: How many numbers to return. Capped server-side per kind; defaults to a sensible per-kind default.

tools.name: convert-base
tools.description: Convert a number from one base to another (2-64). Common shorthands: to=2 for binary, to=8 for octal, to=16 for hex. Requires a math.tools API token (numbers:* ability).

number.description: The number to convert (read in the "from" base).

tools.name: number-theory-check
tools.description: Run a primality/shape check on a number, or get its prime factorization. Requires a math.tools API token (numbers:* ability).

tools.name: number-properties
tools.description: Divisor-related properties of a number: abundant/deficient/squarefree checks, Euler's totient, divisor count/sum, aliquot sum, or whether two numbers are coprime. Requires a math.tools API token (numbers:* ability).

property.description: Which property to compute. 'coprime' needs a and b instead of number.

number.description: Required for every property except 'coprime'. Must be >= 1.

tools.name: equation-image
tools.description: Render a math equation (compact LaTeX-like markup) as a PNG image. Requires a math.tools API token (equations:image ability).

equation.description: The equation, using math.tools' compact LaTeX-like markup — e.g. 'x^2 - y^2 = (x-y)', 'sqrt{x^2+y^2}'.

fontsize.description: Font size in points. Defaults to the site default; clamped to the supported min/max server-side.
